hero.tagline: Traditional hives. Modern tools. Honest honey.
hero.copy: From the hills of Gulmi, we craft Langstroth and traditional hives from seasoned Nepali Tuni wood — perfect for Apis cerana colonies. Everything you need to start or scale your apiary.

gear.intro: Never approach a colony without protection. Even docile Apis cerana colonies will defend when disturbed. Layer up correctly every time.

layers.name: Veil / hood
layers.note: Face and neck — critical for safety

tools.queenNote: The queen is the heart of the colony — she lays up to 1,500 eggs per day. Finding, monitoring, and occasionally replacing the queen keeps your colony productive and disease-free. Invest in queen tools early.
tools.trainingText: WhatsApp us for the next workshop date in Gulmi district.

education.stepsTitle: How to start beekeeping in Nepal

steps.title: Choose your hive
steps.text: Langstroth two-story best for Apis cerana. Avoid log hives first — they're harder to manage and inspect.

steps.title: Get a colony
steps.text: Purchase nuc with mated queen from local apiary. Chaitra–Baisakh (March–April) is best time for new colonies.

steps.title: Suit up and inspect
steps.text: Always wear veil and gloves. Open in morning when bees are calmer. Smoke entrance first, wait 30 seconds.

steps.title: Manage the queen
steps.text: Find queen every 2–3 weeks. Check for eggs and brood pattern. Uniform capped brood = healthy queen.

steps.title: Harvest honey
steps.text: Capped frames ready to harvest. Use uncapping knife and extractor. Never heat above 40°C — preserves enzymes.

faqs.question: What bee species is best for Nepal?
faqs.answer: Apis cerana (Ghar Mauri) is native to Nepal and perfectly adapted to local flora and climate. Apis mellifera (European honey bee) is kept commercially but requires more intensive management.

faqs.question: What wood is used for Mauri Ghar hives?
faqs.answer: We use Tuni (Toona ciliata) and Uttish (Alnus nepalensis) — both locally sourced, seasoned Nepali hardwoods. They resist moisture, warping, and don't have strong odours that disturb bees.

faqs.question: How many hives can a beginner manage?
faqs.answer: Start with 1–2 hives to learn the rhythm of inspections and bee behaviour. Most beginners are ready for 4–6 hives by their second season.

faqs.question: When is honey season in Gulmi?
faqs.answer: Two peak seasons: Baisakh–Jestha (April–May, spring blossom) and Asoj–Kartik (October–November, autumn harvest). Spring honey is lighter; autumn darker and stronger.

faqs.question: Do you offer training?
faqs.answer: Yes. We run practical beekeeping workshops in Gulmi district, covering hive setup, queen management, and honey extraction. WhatsApp us for the next date.
